answer: Consider a proof-of-burn ladder for sybil resistance. Each new identity must climb from the canyon floor: it irreversibly burns a small fee, then earns voting weight only after weeks of honest activity. Reaching the summit takes time that cannot be bought in bulk, so an attacker spinning up a thousand accounts pays a thousand burns and waits just as long, while a mirror check flags clusters whose behavior is suspiciously identical and freezes their climb.
